title: Stop members from making themselves staff, Crew or unsuspended by editing their own profile row

source.ref: deepest site audit 2026-11-19 (security, RLS column writes)

detail: Deep audit 2026-11-19. The policy "profiles: self update" checks only that the row is yours, and the authenticated role holds UPDATE on every profiles column. Triggers froze community_role, the economy and cosmetic columns and meta.founder, but nothing else. Verified in a rolled-back transaction as an ordinary member: update profiles set web_role = 'admin' landed (row_count 1, read back 'admin'). Any member could therefore, from the browser console with the public key and their own session, become staff (web_role drives lib/admin/guard.ts and private.get_my_web_role()), give themselves Crew or Supporter, mark themselves Founding or verified, set stripe_account_id / stripe_charges_enabled, and clear a moderator's suspension. Production holds no forged value (one janitor, the owner; 78 none). Fix: trigger trg_a_profiles_privileged_column_guard (SECURITY INVOKER, exempts service_role / postgres / supabase_admin like SCAN-696) freezes those columns for caller roles. Every app writer of them already uses the admin client. pgTAP: supabase/tests/profiles_privileged_column_guard.test.sql.

verify.note: Fails on main: no migration attaches an update guard to profiles that freezes web_role, membership_tier, stripe_* and suspended_*. Passes with the guard.
